expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The reply gives the steps that bring receipts back: check and start the larder-worker service, and confirm through
the waiting jobs in procrastinate_jobs that the receipts go out.
expectations.evidence: The reply instructs to check 'systemctl status larder-worker', count queue status via 'psql larder -c "select status, count(*) from procrastinate_jobs group by status"', start the worker with 'sudo systemctl start larder-worker', and monitor until 'todo' reaches zero, plus escalate with 'journalctl -u larder-worker -n 50' and 'flag Tomás' — matching all core elements of the reference answer.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The reply names both the larder-worker service and the procrastinate_jobs table.
